messages:
alice: Heads-up — I found a couple broken links in the runtime docs when following the migration path. Pages returning 404: /docs/runtime-config/migration-2024 and the sample config snippet link.
ben: which links exactly? can you paste the URLs so I can repro quickly?
alice: sure: https://redwood.internal/docs/runtime-config/migration-2024 and this markdown link in /docs/runtime-config/quickstart.md -> [example-config](https://s3.redwood.internal/configs/runtime-example.yaml) (both 404 for me).
carol: thanks for flagging @alice. I think the migration doc got moved during the content reorganization last week. I can take ownership and open a PR to restore or redirect.
docs-bot: Automated note: page ownership missing -> /docs/runtime-config/migration-2024 (no @owner metadata). Please add an owner in the frontmatter to avoid future drift.
sam: quick question — do we prefer adding a redirect in Nginx (infra) or keeping a shadow doc here with updated links? Redirect is quicker but leaves content drift risk.
ben: redirect + tiny shadow doc could be safest: redirect immediately to avoid 404s, then PR with restored content / frontmatter to make ownership explicit.
carol: ok I'll do that. Plan: 1) add Nginx redirect rule (infra ping) 2) add migration-2024.md with frontmatter owner: carol 3) fix the broken markdown link to point to the new S3 path or move the example into repo.
alice: perfect. can you drop the PR link here once ready? i'll do a quick QA on the restored content.
carol: will do. tagging @ben to review infra redirect once I open the infra PR.
ben: yep, happy to review. If you want I can pre-approve the redirect rule (small change).
carol: opening PRs now — infra PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4827 (redirect), docs PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/1345 (migration doc + owner).
alice: thanks! quick QA notes: please ensure the sample config link uses: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/configs/runtime-example-2024.yaml (otherwise it'll hit the old S3 path).
carol: updated docs PR with the new artifact URL and added frontmatter owner: "carol".
docs-bot: Auto-check passed: frontmatter owner present, linkcheck warning cleared in draft.
sam: nice — marking this as resolved from my side. thanks all :thumbsup:
